scope: All persisted local Node/probe provider entries at this checkpoint. Native Worker isolate-local sessions are excluded unless separately captured. Development chat tokens are excluded. Every entry represents one request, not cumulative counters.

JEV and voice/STT cost fields are estimates; OpenRouter cost fields were returned by completed requests.
Cancelled requests with no returned usage are counted but their tokens/billing unavailable.
Synthetic STT duration includes submitted silence; audio duration is not token usage.
